title: The Moderate Congress 1885 1905
definition: The Moderate phase represents the initial period of the Indian National Congress (INC) characterized by a belief in British justice, constitutional agitation, and the '3P' method (Prayer, Petition, Protest).
importanceInUpsc: This topic is foundational for understanding the evolution of Indian nationalism, the ideological divide between Moderates and Extremists, and the economic critique of colonialism.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Moderate Congress 1885 1905.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
